messages:
Jamie: Quick follow-up from the RFC — proposing we treat 'consent zone' as a first-class attribute on tenant leases. Goal: enable operator-driven soft cutovers between regions while preserving legal residency proofs. Sketching flow here, want quick sanity checks before I turn it into an ops playbook.

Priya: +1 to making residency explicit. How do we avoid split-brain for KV ownership during a rapid failover? My worry: stale cache in the old region still accepting writes if proxy routing is inconsistent.

Diego: Thinking of a 3-phase cutover: (1) prewarm — async replicate/prime target region cache (no writes), (2) flip — proxy flips `X-Region-Hint`/route preference to target, (3) drain — old region drains in-flight, confirm lease finalization. Need a signed 'residency-proof' token so audits can show which region was primary at time T.

Jamie: Proposed lease shape (high-level): `lease = { tenant_id, region, issued_at, expiry, thumbprint, signature }`. Signature is Redwood-signed by default, with an optional binding to customer KMS. Proof avoids global locks and gives cryptographic audit trail.

Priya: TTL strategy: avoid very small TTLs. Suggest default 120s with jitter and exponential backoff. Operator can `--force` to shorten during emergency. Also propose a 'grace' window: reads allowed from both, writes only to primary region for N seconds after flip.

Diego: Quick simulation example: `curl -H "X-Region-Hint: eu-west-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://proxy.redwood/api/v1/tenants/T123/requests` — proxy uses header to prefer target when testing.

Diego: Local cutover tool (devops): `./devops/cutover --tenant T123 --to eu-west-1 --prewarm --confirm` (dry-run prints missing residency proofs and expected primaries).

SRE-Bot: incident-bot: Staging canary attempt failed: prewarm handshake timed out (~30s). Tagging @Priya @Diego for investigation.

Priya: On it. Likely a staging network ACL blocked cross-region priming. I’ll add an explicit prewarm connectivity check and a retry/backoff knob.

Jamie: Action items:
- Priya: run TTL + prewarm connectivity tests in staging and report numbers
- Diego: draft operator runbook + CLI flags and dry-run semantics
- Jamie: update RFC with lease interface + residency-proof examples and audit schema
Target: playbook PR by EOW. :raising_hand:

Diego: One more edge-case — KMS rotation during cutover. Include key thumbprint in lease and verify signature before finalizing; if verification fails, roll back route.

Jamie: Good call. Will add HSM/KMS binding detail and a rollback policy to the RFC. Also proposing a small dashboard for cutovers: `cutover_success_rate`, `cutover_handshake_latency`, `proof_verification_failures`.

Priya: LGTM. If everyone else is ok, I’ll start running tests tomorrow morning and post results here.
